title: Plan Servicing Console Reference: Patient Payment Plans Add-On Fee Entry
content:
On a Patient Payment Plans tier whose setup fee is above 0.00, every add-on booked on the plan is also charged an add-on fee, booked on the plan balance as one enrollment entry of the reason setup fee on the day the add-on is enrolled.

## Condition of the fee

The add-on fee is not fixed until the plan carries the add-on enrollment entry it is charged for.

Stated against the plan's ledger: an add-on fee is fixed only for an add-on enrollment entry that already stands on the plan.

## The add-on fee entry

| Tier's setup fee | Add-on booked on the plan | Add-on fee entry |
|---|---|---|
| Above 0.00 | Yes | One entry of the reason setup fee on the plan balance, dated the day the add-on is enrolled, with no charge reference |
| 0.00 | Yes | None under this rule |

Each add-on booked on the plan is charged its own add-on fee.

## Console action: `enroll_add_on_fee_792da8e6`

**Capability.** Books an add-on fee of an active payment plan into that plan's balance, as one fee entry of the plan's ledger. One call adds one plan ledger entry of the kind "balance enrolled" with the enrollment reason `setup_fee`, dated today and carrying no financial-account charge reference, and raises the plan's remaining balance by the amount given.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `enroll_add_on_fee_792da8e6`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payment_plan_id` | Reference number of the active payment plan whose balance is charged, as shown by the payment plan lookup for the patient | Identifier |
| `amount` | The add-on fee booked into the plan balance | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; stored exactly as given, rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new plan ledger entry reference (text beginning "ppt_"), the payment plan reference, the fee booked in USD with 2 decimal places and the plan's remaining balance including the fee in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving this sentence means the fee is booked; afterwards the plan's ledger lists the fee entry and the plan's remaining balance includes it.
